name: Youth Activist Committee
city: New York City (citywide, meets in person and online)
what_you_do: Join other teens to work on safer streets, better buses and subways, and bike access. You go to monthly meetings and social hangouts and help with campaigns like free student transit.
who_can_apply: Open to all NYC youth, including current students and recent graduates. No experience needed. The page gives no age range.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer activism. No cost is listed.
duration: Monthly meetings. The NYC Public Schools opportunities page lists the last Friday of the month, 4:30 to 6:00 PM (subject to change).
deadline_text: No deadline. The NYC Public Schools opportunities page lists it as rolling.
how_to_apply: Email youth@transalt.org with questions or use the RSVP link on the Youth Activist Committee page. Meetings are hybrid, and in person is encouraged.
notes: The page describes youth activism and does not mention a work permit. The page lists meetings on the last Friday of each month from 4:30 to 6 PM, and says meetings are hybrid. Confirm before you go.
